title: Cooperative-catalysis CIPS condensates on a consumed fuel die within ~500 t when fuel regrowth stops (2/2 seeds) while their fed twins persist unchanged, but at a finer grid their rods and dumbbells are frozen (14 bodies, t=7000-15500): bodies that need their fuel, no division
summary: Follows 20261026T0301-c35-cips-coop-rods-negative (world.py: kc F e^2 (1-p), kc=2, De=0.1, chi=3, DF=2, kF=0.2, e0=0.12, enzyme turnover d=0.0001, from uniform e0 plus noise 0.02). (1) Fuel fork, 192^2, seeds 0 and 1: kF set to 0 everywhere at t=8000. The 13 and 11 bodies (rods and droplets nucleated from noise at t~3000-7000) are all gone by t=8500 (fork_s0.png: blurred at t=8125, uniform by t=8750). The fed twins, identical until t=8000, keep 13 and 11 bodies of unchanged mean area (317 and 374 px) to t=30000 (fed_twin_s*_t30000.png, fed_s*_counts.json). Turnover cannot explain this, since 1/d = 10000 t, so each body needs the fuel it consumes, as in c23's linear-catalysis world; the bodies are also size-capped and do not coarsen. (2) Resolution: the same world at Lsc=5 (features 5/3 larger in pixels), dt=0.05, 320^2, seed 0 (lsc5_rods_frozen.png, lsc5_counts.json). 14 bodies nucleate by t~7000; several stretch into rods (curved and at mixed angles, so the rods are not only grid anisotropy) and one into a dumbbell with a thin waist by t~10000. The count stays at 14 from t=7000 to 15500 and the dumbbell does not pinch, so nothing divides. (3) Screen (nr_coop_screen.png): c23's two-enzyme non-reciprocal world with the same cooperative catalysis (world_nr.py, n=2) gives either no bodies (e10=0.15, e20=0.1, chi12=3, chi21=-3) or static e1 droplets (e10=0.16, e20=0.06, chi12=1.5, chi21=-1.5) by t=3000 at 128^2. Limits: fork at Lsc=3 only; Lsc=5 is one seed to t=15500 (stopped at my deadline) with no fork; the turnover is a decay term, so E may be scored under mechanism although dissolution is 20x faster than 1/d.

finding.operator: cooperative catalysis-induced condensation with weak enzyme turnover on a consumed, regrowing fuel
finding.control: fuel fork (kF=0 at t=8000) against the fed twin on seeds 0 and 1; finer grid Lsc=5, dt=0.05
finding.result: fork: 13/11 bodies -> 0 by t=8500, fed twins 13/11 to t=30000; Lsc=5: 14 bodies constant t=7000-15500, dumbbell stationary, 0 divisions
